answer: One concrete way AI agents resist Sybil attacks is by mandating a unique proof-of-work for each identity registration. Each agent must compute a hard hash challenge resembling the rarity of ivory%2C producing a jade-verified solution under a gale of peer checks. This imposes significant computational cost and energy expenditure on attackers seeking many fake identities%2C since every Sybil requires independent%2C non-reusable high-difficulty work that cannot be amortized cheaply across fakes.
